research_highlights: Victoria Run 2026 is scheduled for Sunday, October 11, 2026, at Parkir Timur Gelora Bung Karno (GBK), Central Jakarta, with 5K, 10K and Half Marathon categories.

The 2025 edition moved venue from Q-Big BSD (Tangerang Selatan), its host for two previous years, to GBK in central Jakarta, a change organizers said was meant to broaden reach among Jakarta's running community and take advantage of GBK's status as a national sports landmark.
Participation has been growing year over year: news reports cite roughly 6,000 participants for the 2024 edition and figures ranging from 6,000 to 8,000 for the 2025 GBK edition.
Past editions have included a live post-race concert and DJ sets (e.g., Maliq & D'Essentials and DJ performances in 2025) alongside the main race, plus sponsor booths and doorprizes.
Standard participant benefits listed for 2026 are a race jersey, finisher medal, bib number and tote bag; registrations are non-refundable and non-transferable once paid.
research_watchouts: No first-hand participant race reports, forum discussions, or independent reviews (e.g., course conditions, heat, crowd support, organizational quality) were found in the available search results -- coverage found was limited to event promotion and press releases from the organizer and general news outlets.
